COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
23.10.2024 FA No. 173 of 2018
Sri Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.
Sri Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.
1. Mr. Ganga Singh Negi, learned counsel for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. Arun Pratap Shah, learned counsel for the 
respondent.
3. In sequel to the order dated 13.08.2023, 
appellant is present, however, respondent has not 
appeared before the Court.
4. Since the appellant has come all the way from 
Kotdwar after incurring travel and other miscellaneous 
expenses, therefore, we direct the respondent to pay 
Rs.6,000/- as travel and other miscellaneous expenses 
to the appellant.
5. Learned counsel for the respondent undertakes 
to handover the aforesaid amount to learned counsel 
for the appellant, after collecting the same from his 
client within forty-eight hours.
6. List on 30.12.2024.
7. Parties shall appear before Mediation Centre 
attached to Family Court, Kotdwar, District Pauri 
Garhwal, on 25.11.2024. Mediator’s report shall be 
placed before this Court within two weeks thereafter.
(Vivek Bharti Sharma, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, A.C.J.)
 23.10.2024 23.10.2024
NISHANT
